candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: The archive provides time-stamped DSM raster elevation data at 25cm, 50cm, 1m and 2m depending on survey requirements.
The DSM is produced from the last-return signal and includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain.
Data is aligned to the OS Grid, referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn and declares +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
The transformation is specific to the survey time period and the metadata catalogue records survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model.
semantic_limits: A DSM tile cannot substitute for bare-earth DTM merely because date, nominal resolution, datum or RMSE appear compatible; surface semantics and exact survey lineage remain mandatory.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) - 2m
verified_facts: The 2m DSM covers about 99% of England and is produced from the last or only laser return.
It includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as the terrain surface.
Where repeat surveys exist the newest best-resolution data is used and resampling uses bilinear interpolation.
The dataset declares EPSG:27700 and +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: The 2m last-return DSM is a surface-object and scale control only; it is not a parcel ground-height accuracy upgrade and cannot replace the 1m DTM primary samples.
